_about: TradeLink product facts that generated content may state. 'published' = stated consistently on usetradelink.com on the date given; 'disputed' or 'needs_confirmation' facts must not be used until the product owner confirms them. Update 'status' and 'verified_on' only from an owner decision or a primary source.

facts.statement: TradeLink costs $40/month on a single plan.
One plan covers up to 150 accounts.
Futures accounts connect through a Tradovate login.
Rithmic is coming soon and is not live.

facts.note: Homepage FAQ says NinjaTrader is supported; every other page and llms.txt say Tradovate only. Owner decision pending (issue #10, H8).

facts.statement: Followers can copy 1:1, by multiplier or by fixed quantity.
Follower orders are placed from the leader's fills; partial fills can copy as they happen.
The copier runs server-side; the browser does not need to stay open.
Risk rules such as daily loss and profit limits can pause, flatten or lock one follower or a whole group.

facts.note: Claimed in four places but the rules are never listed (issue #10, M16).

facts.statement: Includes a trade journal with CSV export.
Traders switching from another futures copier get the first month free plus $20 after the first successful renewal, with proof of cancellation.
There is no standard free trial.

forbidden_claims: guaranteed fills or identical results across accounts
approval or endorsement by any prop firm or broker
compatibility with a broker, platform or prop firm not listed as published above
undetectable copying or avoiding prop firm rules
personal testing, user stories, quotes or reviews that do not exist
